newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, bids/offers far apart in 1998.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, bids/offers far apart in 1998.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract got the week off to a slow start on Monday, with no trade done even though bids and offers were posted for all periods by the close.
Natural gas futures are often quiet on a Monday, brokers said, as many companies use the day to plan the week's trading strategy and are frequently not active in the market.
Both July and August were bid at 9.80 pence a therm against offers at 10.00 pence by the close, with September in a slightly wider spread of 9.80/10.20 pence a therm.
From January 1998, the bid/offer spread widened out considerably, with January itself posted at 17.20/17.90 pence while February was marginally wider at 17.20/17.95 pence.
The lack of trade followed a relatively busy day on Friday, when 250 lots were traded.
